title: 第87章 第一批名单，我要让他开不起来！
content_zh:
第87章 第一批名单，我要让他开不起来！-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

藏锋的第一批名单，定得很快。

顾城把沪上圈子里能说得上话的人捋了一遍。

苏晚棠按主业、资源、风险点做了表。

叶知秋又从公司风控角度过了一遍。

最后，名单放到林川桌上。

林川拿笔，划掉了最后几个人。

第一批会员，十五个。

顾城、陈怀民、赵屿、徐子谦、陈放舟，陆承安都在。

顾清烟没有入股。

但顾氏安保团队，已经开始跟苏晚棠对接。

齐衡那边的“北屋”，也被留了下来。

藏锋的装修方案同步推进。

老洋房外立面不动。

木楼梯修旧如旧。

二楼主茶室保留彩色玻璃窗。

院子里的老梧桐，只做根系保护，不动一枝主干。

苏晚棠给出时间表。

“最快四十五天试运营。”

顾城嫌慢。

“不能再快点？”

苏晚棠看他。

“顾少，修老洋房不是给兰博基尼贴膜。”

顾城闭嘴。

林川把装修图合上。

“四十五天可以。”

试运营四十五天后，正式开业预计两个月。

消息和第一批名单，很快传到了外面。

有人拿到了位置。

有人连门都摸不到。

陆骁就是后者。

他家里做高端建材和酒店软装，在上海本地有些根基。

父亲陆启明靠着几家老牌酒店起家，这几年又接了不少地产精装项目。

家里资产不算顶尖，但在上海这个圈子里，算得上有名有姓。

陆骁平时也玩车，也喝酒，也混私局。

他最喜欢一句话。

“上海圈子不大，抬头低头都得见。”

这话他讲得多，别人也给面子。

久而久之，他就真以为自己处处有面子。

藏锋的消息传出来后，陆骁压根没问自己能不能进。

他默认自己一定在名单上。

甚至前一天晚上，他还在酒吧里跟人说：

“林川这个茶楼，想做起来，肯定要借本地人的桌子。到时候我去看看，合适就给他捧捧场。”

旁边几个人跟着笑。

有人问：“陆少，听说第一批才十五个名额。”

陆骁晃着杯子。

“十五个怎么了？上海就这么大，真懂圈子的，能漏掉我？”

第二天下午，名单传出来。

没有陆骁。

他起初不信。

“谁传的？”

朋友说：“顾城那边出来的。”

陆骁皱眉。

“顾城喝多了吧？”

朋友没接。

陆骁当场给一个熟人打电话。

那人跟顾城走得近。

电话接通，陆骁语气还算平稳。

“藏锋名单是不是还有第二版？我这边没看到我名字。”

对面沉默了一下。

“陆少，第一批名单已经定了。”

“谁定的？”

“林总亲自定的。”

“我问的是，我是不是被漏了？”

“不是漏。”

对面说得很慢。

“你被划掉了。”

包厢里很吵。

这四个字落下来，陆骁半天没说话。

Zang Feng’s first batch of lists was finalized very quickly.

Gu Cheng went through the list of people in the Shanghai circle who could speak.

Su Wantang made a table based on main business, resources, and risk points.

Ye Zhiqiu went through it again from the company's risk control perspective.

Finally, the list was placed on Lin Chuan's table.

Lin Chuan took a pen and crossed out the last few people.

The first batch of members, fifteen.

Gu Cheng, Chen Huaimin, Zhao Yu, Xu Ziqian, Chen Fangzhou and Lu Chengan were all there.

Gu Qingyan did not invest in the shares.

But Gu's security team has already begun to contact Su Wantang.

The "North House" on Qi Heng's side was also left behind.

Zangfeng’s decoration plan is being advanced simultaneously.

The facade of the old bungalow remains unchanged.

The wooden stairs are as old as ever.

The main tea room on the second floor retains stained glass windows.

The old sycamore tree in the yard only protects its root system, leaving its trunk untouched.

Su Wantang gave a timetable.

"Trial operation will take place within forty-five days at the earliest."

Gu Cheng felt too slow.

"Can't it go any faster?"

Su Wantang looked at him.

"Young Master Gu, repairing an old house is not about putting a wrap on a Lamborghini."

Gu Cheng shut up.

Lin Chuan closed the decoration drawing.

"Forty-five days is fine."

After 45 days of trial operation, the official opening is expected to take two months.

The news and the first batch of lists quickly spread outside.

Someone got a spot.

No one can even touch the door.

Lu Xiao is the latter.

His family is engaged in high-end building materials and hotel soft decoration, and has some local roots in Shanghai.

His father, Lu Qiming, started his business with several well-established hotels. In recent years, he has taken on many real estate decoration projects.

The family's assets are not top-notch, but they are considered well-known in Shanghai circles.

Lu Xiao usually plays cars, drinks, and engages in private affairs.

One of his favorite words.

"Shanghai's circle is not very big, you can see it even if you look up or down."

He said this often, and others gave him face.

Over time, he really thought that he had face everywhere.

After the news about Zang Feng came out, Lu Xiao didn't even ask if he could enter.

He tacitly agreed that he must be on the list.

Even the night before, he told people in the bar:

"If I want to start this teahouse in Linchuan, I will definitely need to borrow tables from local people. When the time comes, I will go and have a look. If it suits me, I will support him."

Several people nearby laughed.

Someone asked: "Master Lu, I heard that there are only fifteen places in the first batch."

Lu Xiao shook the cup.

"What's wrong with fifteen? Shanghai is such a big place. If you really know the world, can you miss me?"

The next afternoon, the list came out.

There is no Lu Xiao.

He didn't believe it at first.

"Who passed it on?"

The friend said: "He came from Gu Cheng."

Lu Xiao frowned.

"Did Gu Cheng drink too much?"

My friend didn't answer.

Lu Xiao called an acquaintance on the spot.

That man was close to Gu Cheng.

When the call was connected, Lu Xiao's tone was quite calm.

"Is there a second version of the Zangfeng list? I don't see my name here."

There was silence on the other side.

"Master Lu, the first batch of names has been decided."

"Who decided?"

"Mr. Lin decided it himself."

"What I'm asking is, am I being left out?"

"It's not a leak."

The other person spoke very slowly.

"You're crossed out."

It was very noisy in the box.

After these four words fell, Lu Xiao didn't speak for a long time.
